# ReferendumCitoyen — account brief

## Who
ReferendumCitoyen is a GitHub organization with 2 public repos and 5 followers ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen)). The evidence does not say what the company does beyond its repos, so the product and team behind the org are unknown.

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in the referendum-citoyen-react-native repo ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/43491341be34867aa9e392192d581e0b2cbe76c2/eas.json))
- The repo pins react-native 0.81.5 in package.json ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/package.json))
- CI workflows run from .github/workflows in the same repo ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/tree/develop/.github/workflows))

## Why now
The repo was last pushed on 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native)). It is on react-native 0.81.5, a current release line ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/package.json)). The evidence contains nothing on store update cadence or review volume.

## Suggested opener
I saw that referendum-citoyen-react-native ships with an eas.json checked in ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/eas.json)) and runs CI through GitHub Actions ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/tree/develop/.github/workflows)). You pushed as recently as August 11 on react-native 0.81.5 ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native)) ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/package.json)). Are your EAS builds and store submissions wired into those workflows, or is someone still kicking off release builds by hand?
